name: 54-check-diagrams
title: Проверка диаграмм: исходники и экспорт
command: Get-ChildItem docs/diagrams, db/erd -File | Select-Object Name, Length | Format-Table -AutoSize

name: 49-db-deploy
title: Проверка развёрнутой базы: таблицы и число столбцов
sql:
SELECT t.table_name AS таблица, count(c.column_name) AS столбцов
FROM information_schema.tables t
JOIN information_schema.columns c ON c.table_name = t.table_name AND c.table_schema = t.table_schema
WHERE t.table_schema = 'public' AND t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
GROUP BY t.table_name
ORDER BY t.table_name;
